name: Personality
summary: Write Alexia a personality in your own words, save as many as you like, and switch between them.

requires.why: to offer the facts about you it found in your description to long-term memory, once, when you press the button

settings.label: Describe her in your own words
settings.placeholder: blunt, chief of staff, calls me Vacen, no emojis, chases the dates I set myself
settings.hint: Rough notes are the point. Adapt turns them into a proper personality — you do not have to write one.

settings.label: Save it as
settings.hint: The name it appears under below. Leave it empty and the wording above names it.

settings.label: Use one of them somewhere else
settings.hint: Type where — the name of the plugin you talk to her through — then press Use there on the row. A reply read on a phone wants to be shorter than one at the desk. Leave it empty and press Use there to unbind.

settings.label: Change something about one of them
settings.placeholder: more blunt, and stop saying “man to man”
settings.hint: Type the change, then press Refine on the row it is about. The previous version is kept.

settings.label: Or write it yourself
settings.placeholder:
# Chief of staff

## Who you are
…
settings.hint: Open a row to read what she is being told, paste it here, change it, then press Edit on that row. The same checks run as on Adapt.

settings.label: Hear her before switching
settings.hint: Adapt saves her without switching, and two sample answers come back so you know what you are choosing. Turn this off and Adapt switches straight away, the way it used to.

options.label: What your chat gives her
options.hint: The length the model your chat asks first is given, on that model. The sample says which one that is.

options.label: Short
options.hint: About 100 words, on a model your chat would give the short one to: a small model or a router.

options.label: Medium
options.hint: About 300 words, on a model your chat would give the medium one to: a free model of 7B or more.

options.label: Full
options.hint: About 600 words, on a model your chat would give the full one to. Those are paid models, so with paid models on under Models this costs money, and the sample says how much. With them off, it is heard on the strongest free model instead.

settings.label: Adapt
settings.hint: One model call to write it, and two short ones to hear her. Nothing switches until you press Use.

settings.label: Saved personalities
settings.hint: Use switches her over from the next thing you say. Use there binds one to a place you talk to her through instead. Hear her asks two sample questions in her voice first. Open a row to read exactly what she is being told, and the words it was adapted from.

settings.label: Speak plainly
settings.hint: Stops using any of them. Nothing is deleted, and Alexia goes back to her own voice.

commands.name: persona
commands.summary: List your saved personalities, or switch to one by name

commands.name: plainly
commands.summary: Stop using any personality — Alexia goes back to her own voice
